# Unit Tests

## Gorman Variable Creation

### get_vars_gorman()

The primary barrier is the fact that running variables with an existing feature set is actually slower than running them without one (i.e., it's slower when the `presupplied_variables` argument is filled).

I put the source code of the original below.

```{r, v1-source-code}

```{r, test-that-index_to_rows}
testthat::test_that("index_to_rows() gets_valid_row", {
  m1 <- as.matrix(penguins)
  for (i in seq(1, 1000)) {
    sampled <- sample(length(m1), 1)
    testthat::expect_lte(index_to_row(sampled, m1), nrow(m1))
    testthat::expect_gt(index_to_row(sampled, m1), 0)
  }
})
```
